test_title: PYST 27: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80d21cba4806e7b6bf5e93df119777eec63e95efec191eba8a7c0881c4de2fb1.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : first column

 
• Alternately elements in first column shifts to third column diagonally.
 
• Alternately element in second column remains constant.
 
• Alternately element in third column shifts to first column.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d31be274934820bbc67a9ac76a80a29ad3b2660bf593ddf61ba0ac771aa4983.png] 

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately first row elements shifts in the anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately element in second column is replaced by new element i.e 'Y' is replaced by '6' and '6' is replaced by 'C'.
 
• Alternately second row elements shifts in the clockwise direction. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2ccb970ea4d79f4937fdb2b516f3a5abc0c02e9a0b9e567e91433520277cf9b.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5fe9ff3d5f98048156caeb198759cf4270ff7738e930305b8ced8373733eb9.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (3)’ is the correct answer.
